regime_detail: DV-1 and F1 are scored on the data-only (D) run at shuffle seed 20261010; knowledge runs are D+K and are not scored; PyWhy-LLM has no data interface, so its only regime is K (recorded as D+K, data-only relation 'none'), and it ran on the offline stub

metric_defs.dv1: decision_value_v2.claims with every variable as a target: coverage = committed (target, variable) claims / d(d-1); precision_committed = share of committed yes/no claims matching the true graph's reachability
metric_defs.f1: directed-edge F1 (causalarena_io.directed_scores), undecided pairs oriented by the random rule seeded crc32(file name); f1_drop_undecided also given
metric_defs.ledger_checks: ledger/verify.py V1-V8 on ledgers written by analysis/ab11_ledger_adapters.py from what each tool exposes
